title: Synthetic sensitivity calibration of the T2-E1 probe screen
purpose: Quantify null behavior and detection rates for known synthetic history signals using the T2-E1 step-2 all-token probe dimensions and screening rule. No natural Transformer hypothesis test is performed.
scope: One synthetic calibration configuration; new independent simulated datasets. No actual Transformer checkpoint is loaded, trained, changed, or used for tuning. T2-E1 and all earlier empirical results remain closed.
rng_rule: base + replicate*100 + dataset_slot; replicate and slot are zero-indexed
generator: For every current coordinate, past coordinate, and independent noise scalar: (independent standard Gaussian family component + independent standard Gaussian member component)/sqrt(2). Coordinates and X/H/noise blocks independent; pairs share family component.
scenario_reuse: Within a replicate/dataset, all deltas use the same X, H, epsilon and feature transforms. Replicates independent. Scenario rates are paired, not independent across deltas.

features.current_rff: X plus 36 cosine random Fourier features of training-standardized X; W_ij~N(0,1/388), bias~Uniform(0,2pi), scaled sqrt(2/36)

ridge.selection: minimum validation MSE; exact ties choose larger alpha
ridge.standardization: training-only feature mean and population SD with floor 1e-8
ridge.solve: Same ridge normal-equation/eigendecomposition calculation as T2-E1; share feature decompositions across target scenarios, which does not change each fitted solution

aggregation: Equal weight across the six independent simulated datasets in each replicate. One step per dataset; no step-selection or chronology claim.

bootstrap.rule: Common draws across both comparisons and all signal scenarios within a dataset; independent draws across datasets; bootstrap dataset models fixed

screen: For history against both current_rff and current_linear: mean held-out delta R2 >=0.01, conditional bootstrap lower bound >0, positive held-out delta R2 in all six datasets, and nonnegative mean MAE advantage. Both comparisons must pass.
outputs: per-panel effects, intervals, and individual screen components
detection fraction at each known delta with 95% Wilson Monte Carlo interval
bootstrap panel draws for reproducing decisions
calibration_checks: At most 1/24 null panels may pass, and at least 22/24 panels at planted delta=0.10 must pass. This is a fixed observed-run diagnostic, not a population type-I-error guarantee. No required pass fraction for 0.01 or 0.05; report their measured sensitivity.
limits: Gaussian synthetic observations, an easily accessible linear planted signal, one step, fixed pair correlation, and 24 panel replicates do not reproduce the neural representation geometry or heavy-tailed NLL targets. This is not a calibrated power estimate for natural T2-E1 history signals and cannot retroactively confirm or refute them.
stop_rule: Run all 24 paired scenario panels once, report every result and all screen components, then stop. Do not tune the screen, increase samples, or substitute a neural study after seeing results. Implementation errors may be repaired with a recorded amendment and retained failed logs.
